FROM python:3.13-slim
ENV PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 PORT=10000
RUN useradd --create-home --uid 10001 app && mkdir -p /app && chown app:app /app
WORKDIR /app
COPY --chown=app:app . .
RUN python -m pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt && python -m pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.ascend.txt
USER app
EXPOSE 10000
CMD ["sh", "-c", "exec python -m uvicorn main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port \"${PORT:-10000}\""]

name: Migration container smoke test
on: [push, pull_request]
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  smoke:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    env:
      SMOKE_TEST_PATH: "/health"
      APP_DIR: "."
      HOST_PORT: "10000"
      CONTAINER_PORT: "10000"
      # Existing images may ignore PORT. Confirm the actual listen port before enabling.
      CONTAINER_PORT_REVIEWED: "true"
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Build and smoke test
        working-directory: ${{ env.APP_DIR }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          trap 'docker logs ascend-smoke 2>/dev/null || true; docker rm -f ascend-smoke 2>/dev/null || true' EXIT
          if [[ "$CONTAINER_PORT_REVIEWED" != "true" ]]; then
            echo "::error::Review the existing Dockerfile's actual listen port, set CONTAINER_PORT, then set CONTAINER_PORT_REVIEWED=true. Existing images may ignore PORT."
            exit 1
          fi
          docker build -t ascend-smoke .
          # Add required application environment configuration before enabling this job.
          docker run -d --name ascend-smoke -e PORT="$CONTAINER_PORT" -p "127.0.0.1:${HOST_PORT}:${CONTAINER_PORT}" ascend-smoke
          curl --fail --retry 20 --retry-all-errors --retry-delay 3 --max-time 5 "http://127.0.0.1:${HOST_PORT}${SMOKE_TEST_PATH}"

# Review template; schema fields checked against https://render.com/docs/blueprint-spec
# Nothing is provisioned by Ascend. Review free-tier limits before manual setup.
services:
  - type: web
    name: ascend-app
    runtime: docker
    plan: free
    autoDeployTrigger: "off"
    dockerfilePath: "./Dockerfile"
    dockerContext: "."
    healthCheckPath: "/health"
    envVars:

unresolved_findings.title: Loopback-only server binding
unresolved_findings.explanation: A Python startup call binds to loopback. A guarded development startup block may be overridden by production, but no clear resolving override was established for this call.
unresolved_findings.recommended_fix: Configure the production server to bind to 0.0.0.0 or the platform-required interface.

unresolved_findings.title: Hardcoded application port
unresolved_findings.explanation: A Python startup call uses a literal port. This can be valid, but a PaaS may require an environment-supplied port.
unresolved_findings.recommended_fix: Read the platform port from an environment variable, with an appropriate local default.

unresolved_findings.title: Potential local persistent storage
unresolved_findings.explanation: SQLite, file writes, or local storage configuration may require durable storage. SQLite is not inherently unsuitable; container filesystems may be ephemeral.
unresolved_findings.recommended_fix: Review persistence needs; configure a durable volume or external storage and backups when necessary.
